title: Layer 3 Econometric Model Parameters & Microeconomic Formulas
methodology: Disaggregated microeconomic cost accounting and corporate voting power elasticity model under German Aktiengesetz §179 and EU Regulation 2024/2754.

tariffModel.description: Countervailing duty financial impact on reverse-exported BEVs into the European Union
tariffModel.equation: Delta_EBIT_Tariff = V_export * P_customs * tau * (1 - alpha) + V_export * (tau * alpha * |epsilon|) * (P_customs * gross_margin)

batteryCostModel.description: Non-China battery mineral refining and IRA/CRMA local content compliance cost penalty

chinaShockModel.description: Domestic Chinese market contraction and price war impact on JV equity earnings and dividends

governanceAktgModel.description: German Stock Corporation Act (§179 AktG) 75% Supermajority & Blocking Minority Voting Power Engine
governanceAktgModel.equation: Total_Turnout = S_cn * T_cn + S_allied * T_allied + S_float * T_float; Effective_Power_CN = (S_cn * T_cn) / Total_Turnout
